description: Use this when someone asks how to grow on TikTok, how to get more views or followers, or how to go viral on TikTok, for a specific public TikTok account. Input: the TikTok username, and optionally the creator’s time zone and niche. It reads the account once and returns, in one result, the account’s numbers with its strongest and weakest recent videos and counted patterns, its past posting times against views, a few stored public posts and hashtags from its niche when the niche is known, and a method for laying these out as a plan of things to test. Public data only: it cannot see when followers are online, watch time or audience details. It is a plan to test: it does not predict or promise views, followers or any result.

niche.description: Optional. The account’s niche in plain words, for example skincare or gym. Leave out to take it from the captions. Text.

time_zone.description: Optional. The creator’s time zone as an IANA name, for example America/New_York. Leave out to use UTC. Text.

username.description: Required. The public TikTok username to read, as text, with or without @ (for example nasa), or a tiktok.com profile link.

name: get_tiktok_growth_plan

message.description: One or two plain sentences that say what was found or what went wrong.

detected_from.description: Where the niche came from: the account’s captions, or the niche typed in the request. Never say the captions show a niche that was typed.

niche_trends.description: Up to 4 recent public posts by OTHER creators in the same niche, from a stored weekly sample. null when the niche is unclear or nothing is stored.

patterns.description: Counted across the recent public videos: how many are above the typical views, the hashtags used, and how the opening lines start (with the median views of the videos using each). Counts only: nothing here is a cause.

plan_method.description: How to lay these sections out as a plan.

typical_views_of_counted_videos.description: Median views of the videos counted here (at least 3 days old). times_typical in this block is against this figure, not the top-level typical_views.

posting_times.description: When this account’s own past videos were posted against the views they have now. null when there are too few videos. Never when followers are online.

status.description: ok, or the plain reason there is no result (not_found, private, no_videos, videos_unavailable, not_enough_videos, invalid_input, unknown_niche, niche_needed, no_data, rate_limited, paused, off, busy, unavailable).

strongest_videos.description: The recent public videos with the most views, highest first (up to 3). times_typical compares each with typical_views.

example_url.description: The most-viewed stored post that used the hashtag: cite it as the source.

median_views.description: Median views of the posts that were stored WITH a view count. null = none was: say "no view count", never "0 views".

posts_with_views.description: How many of the posts using the hashtag were stored with a view count.

trending_hashtags.description: Hashtags counted across the stored posts of the niche (up to 8). null when the niche is unclear or nothing is stored.

typical_views.description: Median views of the recent public videos that were read.

weakest_videos.description: The recent public videos with the fewest views, lowest first (up to 3). Videos under 3 days old are left out: they are still collecting views.

title: TikTok growth plan for an account
